Message.Name: NewOrderMessage
Message.Description: New order futures message

Message.Name: ModifyOrderMessage
Message.Description: Request to modify an order

Message.Name: CancelOrderMessage
Message.Description: Request to cancel a single order or quote

Message.Name: MassCancelOrderMessage
Message.Description: A Mass Cancel Order message is a request to cancel a group of orders or quotes

Message.Name: PurgeOrdersMessage
Message.Description: Request to cancel a group of orders or quotes across all the TPH's sessions for that port’s matching unit

Message.Name: QuoteUpdateMessage
Message.Description: Request to enter or update one or more quotes

Message.Name: ResetRiskMessage
Message.Description: Reset or release Firm/EFID, Product, or Custom Group Id level lockout conditions resulting from risk profile trips or self-imposed lockouts issued viaMass Cancel Order or Purge Orders messages

Message.Name: OrderAcknowledgementMessage
Message.Description: Order Acknowledgement messages are sent in response to a new order message

Message.Name: OrderRejectedMessage
Message.Description: Order Rejected messages are sent in response to a New Order which must be rejected

Message.Name: OrderModifiedMessage
Message.Description: Order Modified messages are sent in response to a Modify Order to indicate that the orderhas been successfully modified

Message.Name: ModifyRejectedMessage
Message.Description: Modify Rejected messages are sent in response to a Modify Order for an order which cannot be modified

Message.Name: OrderExecutionMessage
Message.Description: An Order Execution is sent for each fill on an order

Message.Name: OrderCancelledMessage
Message.Description: Order Cancelled message

Message.Name: CancelRejectedMessage
Message.Description: A Cancel Rejected message is sent in response to a Cancel Order message to indicate that the cancellation cannot occur

Message.Name: MassCancelAcknowledgementMessage
Message.Description: A Mass Cancel Acknowledgment is an unsequenced message sent when a Cancel Order or Purge Orders message requesting a mass cancellation has completed cancelling all individual orders

Message.Name: MassCancelRejectedMessage
Message.Description: A Mass Cancel Rejected message is sent in response to a Mass Cancel Order message to indicate that the mass cancellation cannot occur

Message.Name: PurgeAcknowledgementMessage
Message.Description: A Purge Acknowledgment is an unsequenced message sent when a Purge Orders message requesting an order purge has completed cancelling all individual orders

Message.Name: PurgeRejectedMessage
Message.Description: A Purge Rejected message is sent in response to a Purge Orders message to indicate that the mass cancellation cannot occur

Message.Name: TradeCancelOrCorrectMessage
Message.Description: Used to provide notification that a trade has been cancelled or corrected

Message.Name: TasRestatementMessage
Message.Description: A Tas Restatement is sent post-settlement time for each TAS execution during the associated business day to communicate the updated Price and Symbol associated with the cleared execution

Message.Name: VarianceRestatementMessage
Message.Description: A Variance Restatement is sent post-settlement time for each VA and VAO execution during the associated business day to communicate updated Price, Size and Symbol associated with the cleared execution

Message.Name: QuoteUpdateAcknowledgementMessage
Message.Description: Quote Update Acknowledgment messages are sent in response to a Quote Update or Quote Update Option message

Message.Name: QuoteUpdateRejectedMessage
Message.Description: Quote Update Rejected messages are sent in response to a Quote Update or Quote Update Option message when the entire quote block is rejected by the order handler

Message.Name: QuoteRestatedMessage
Message.Description: Quote Restated messages are sent to inform the TPH that an order has been asynchronously modified for some reason by CFE

Message.Name: QuoteExecutionMessage
Message.Description: A Quote Execution message is used to indicate an execution has occurred on a resting quote

Message.Name: QuoteCancelledMessage
Message.Description: A Quote Cancelled message will be sent to indicate an unsolicited cancellation of a quote entered with a Quote Update message

Message.Name: TasQuoteRestatementMessage
Message.Description: A TAS Quote Restatement is sent post-settlement time for each TAS quote execution during the associated business day to communicate the updated Price and Symbol associated with the cleared execution

Message.Name: VarianceQuoteRestatementMessage
Message.Description: A Variance Quote Restatement is sent post-settlement time for each VA and VAO execution during the associated business day to communicate updated Price, Size, and Symbol values associated with the cleared execution

Message.Name: ResetRiskAcknowledgementMessage
Message.Description: Response to a Reset Risk request
